title: Cited strategies show their name and open a page that exists

hosted_verification_note: No VM or SSH access of any kind; no operator keys read. Functional evidence only, using the hosted facts recorded in the task brief (2026-11-25 20:55Z, BFF b3f93d448) and the recorded owner shapes. Hosted verification belongs to the operator acceptance task.
root_cause: cited_evidence.py (#7867) used the artifact id as a strategy id: _route_for linked registry_artifact / member_virtual_book rows to /management/strategies/<artifact> (hosted 404) and _name_for looked the artifact id up in the strategy label directory, which get_strategy_labels keys by strategy id (so artifact-persona-paper-* never got a name). The previous test fixture keyed get_strategy_labels by the artifact id, which hid the defect.
acceptance_as_delivered: 1. registry_artifact and member_virtual_book rows link to /management/artifacts/{artifact} (_artifact_href). test_routes_only_point_at_existing_management_pages asserts no cited href starts with /management/strategies/artifact- and every artifact-kind row links under /management/artifacts/artifact-. Pool (/management/personas/{persona}), evidence (/management/evidence/{id}), meeting/approval/evolution/demand/cycle links and null links are unchanged (asserted in test_artifact_named_by_registry_strategy_one_read_per_distinct_artifact).

2. label_parts = {artifact_id, strategy_id}; strategy_id is the recorded strategy_id of the Registry entry read through the existing owner read behind GET /bff/artifacts/{id} (store.read_registry_strategy_artifact_detail -> GET /api/registry/entries/{artifact}); label is names.strategy(strategy_id). No text rule: test_strategy_id_is_read_from_the_owner_never_derived_from_the_id records strategy-carry-basket-0042 for the artifact while the directory also holds the text-derivable strategy-persona-<hex> under a different name, and the row takes the recorded one; test_failed_artifact_read_keeps_row_unnamed_and_counted shows that with the owner failing the row stays unnamed even though the directory could name the derivable id.

3. Artifact reads run only for non-redacted rows on the visible page, one per distinct artifact id (REG_B, bare ART_B and BOOK_B -> one read), on the existing _ITEM_READ_EXECUTOR via submit_owner_read (request context: caller token + X-Tenant-Id), inside the existing visible-page read wait and the shared MAX_ITEM_READS=20 budget in page order. Failed (owner 503), slow (past the read deadline, cancelled), not-found, other-tenant (tenant_id/owner_tenant not the caller's tenant or __builtin__) or over-budget reads keep label = ref_id, name_missing true, strategy_id null and are counted in meta.item_reads {attempted, resolved, failed, truncated}. Tests: one-read-per-distinct, failed, slow, other-tenant, caller-tenant header, shared cap (30 artifacts -> 20 reads, truncated, unread rows unnamed), redacted rows get no read.

4. An approval cited_by whose parts.target_id is an artifact answered by that same page read carries parts.target_display_name; label stays null. No extra read is made for approval targets (test_approval_targeting_an_artifact_carries_its_strategy_name: still exactly one read per distinct artifact; unanswered artifact target and persona target get no name).

5. The fixture label directory is keyed by strategy id only ({strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa: Carry Basket B}); the Registry answers the recorded RegistryEntryView shape {entry{registry_id, artifact_type: execution_bundle, strategy_id, version, artifact_state, lineage, storage_ref, checksum, metadata, owner_tenant, created_at}, deployment_stage} through the real DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort with only urlopen replaced. Reference shapes are the recorded ones: artifact-persona-paper-<hex>, facts:registry_entry:artifact-persona-paper-<hex>, facts:member_virtual_book:artifact-persona-paper-<hex>, facts:strategy_pool:persona-<hex>@4, evidence:search_excerpt:ko-evi-<hex>-<hex>, mem-<hex>. BFF_API_CONTRACT.md states the new link, label and read-bound rule.

The old value was the defect: hosted GET /bff/strategies/artifact-persona-paper-a81b4fd15944698341aa answers 404, GET /bff/artifacts/ for the same id answers 200 (task brief, 2026-11-25 20:55Z). Acceptance 3 puts artifact reads inside the same 20-read budget, so two of the 20 go to the two distinct artifacts on that page; the bound is asserted on the combined total, which is stricter than before (it now also pins how the budget is spent).

residual_findings: Frontend src/App.tsx is not in this repository; the /management/artifacts/:id page is taken from the hosted fact in the brief (GET /bff/artifacts/{id} 200 and the page named there). The operator acceptance task should open one cited artifact link on hosted.
Registry read for a missing entry: the real port maps 404/403 to (None, 'ok'), so a not-found artifact counts as attempted but neither resolved nor failed in meta.item_reads.
Approval targets that are artifacts but not themselves cited on the visible page are not read (acceptance 4: only when the same read answered it), so they carry no target_display_name.
